elements.content: Once upon a time, a man from the state of Chu was traveling on a boat with his sword. But he dropped his sword into the river carelessly. Immediately, he made a mark on the side of the boat where the sword fell. He hoped to find it later. After the boat stopped, he found the mark and jumped into the river to look for his sword. But he failed. As we know, the boat moved but the sword did not.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 刻舟求剑
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 从前，有个楚国人带着剑乘船。但他不小心把剑掉进了河里。他立刻在剑落水处的船舷上做了一个记号。他希望之后能找到它。船停后，他找到了记号，就跳进河里去找他的剑。但他没有找到。我们知道，船开走了，剑却没有移动。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
